question: Does the noun make a useful decision about which measured returns belong to one physical instance before relation inference? Can the same feasible support and the same word's metric envelope recover geometry beyond every original 3EED proposal on a truly selected object?
source: Use the locked slim v1, frozen three single-source checkpoints and the predecessor's signed single-frame LiDAR and per-noun extents only. No source examples, training, RGB pixels, external experts, target fitting or FINAL.
population: Lock the six-direction ordinary list of 18,620 records, retaining v1 and terrain fallbacks, the earlier 1,204 direction records including natural and controlled descriptions, and the 128 independently executed utterances on 32 physical single-reference-word intervention frames. Run controlled noun panel first, then complete the six-direction comparison regardless of result. The nine content-disjoint Waymo frames from the most recent corroboration panel are a separate post-lock transfer check. Previously exposed scopes remain development evaluations.
graph: Same sampled 16,384 returns, unique XYZ, same fitted ground and foreground height >0.20 m, 8 spatial nearest neighbors and fourth-neighbor core distance as the eight-level predecessor. Full single-linkage hierarchy over unordered mutual-reachability edge weights. At any distance process all tied edges simultaneously. Connected components may not bridge disconnected roots. Retain candidate supports with at least eight distinct returns, the same minimum as the predecessor.
operator: For each of six nouns, the coordinatewise median of its positive metric extents across distinct source-backbone seed locations is the scene's word envelope. Sort horizontal lengths. If no valid positive predictions for a word its branch has no geometry evidence. A node fits if for at least one of 16 uniformly spaced horizontal axes modulo pi its horizontal support spans fit length and width, and its vertical span fits height. All projections use identical axes across nodes. Keep exactly the inclusion-maximal fitting components for that word. Their physical coverage before the eight-return cut is checked point by point. Add maximal fits at the across-word median envelope as the size-blind control. The common solver pool is the union of all these supports.
mark: Retain the previous frozen mean per-return lexical logits, the two-sided dimension compatibility computed from measured PCA boxes and local noun extents, its maximum as stop probability and the same role proposal-overlap priors. For support v, class c has emission mass stop(v)*q(c|v)*1[v is maximal for c]. Remaining probability splits to its children. This yields a normalized distribution over shared nonoverlapping object inventories. After choosing both roles, output the subject box. Several alternative meanings never enter the inference for a particular expression as oracle targets.
controls: Except v1/previous tree, all conditions use identical union, score evidence and returns. Union allows every label on every support. Blind allows all labels only on the maximal median-envelope cut. Same_count nominates as many regions for each word as the main cut using highest unmasked stop times class probability. Wrong_marks rotates whole mark vectors among lexicographically ordered physical centroids by half a frame and preserves exact per-word counts. Independent and wrong_reference use the word-conditioned inventory, switching only relational selection or reference coordinates. Common tie order and fallback.
geometry: On the chosen node compare measured PCA box, historical near-face completion with the local noun dimensions, and near-face completion with the same scene word dimensions and a measured orientation minimizing the largest horizontal span-to-envelope ratio. Use the existing ground rule; the completed box contains every assigned return. For fixed word size and node, report the same word completion at PCA yaw to distinguish size from pose. Controls use the identical geometric operations. Frozen v1/raw and v1/terrain, as well as the previous tree's measured and completed boxes, are literal cached controls. Neither baseline is assigned an invented comparable new geometry.
outcomes: Acc@25/50 use strict oriented IoU. Retain all paired rescues and harms, fixed-node geometry changes, independent box and seed ownership where available, out-of-A256 repairs on the same target, and simultaneous correct decisions on each pair of single-word substitutions. Check both roles from each sentence before claiming four correct endpoints. No target selection of strength, dimensions, angle count, or threshold. Report isolated wins vs v1, tree, equally nominated labels, wrong marks, independent and wrong reference. Do not credit label or relationship effects when a matched placebo has the same effect.
